classes.VERIFIED_PRIMARY: supported directly by an identified primary source appropriate to the claim
classes.VERIFIED_REPOSITORY: supported by inspectable live repository state, commit, tag, release, test result, or canonical artifact
classes.OWNER_ASSERTED: asserted by owner/maintainer but not independently verified
classes.INFERENCE: reasoned conclusion from cited evidence and labelled as inference
classes.THEORETICAL: formal or conceptual proposal not presented as established empirical fact
classes.PREPRINT: claim sourced to a preprint without silently upgrading publication status
classes.SATIRE: deliberately humorous/parodic content; not factual evidence
classes.UNVERIFIED: claim exists but sufficient verification is not established
classes.CONTRADICTED: available evidence directly conflicts with the claim

rules: owner assertion remains OWNER_ASSERTED without independent evidence
derived agreement does not verify upstream truth
satire and fiction remain isolated from factual inference
